raw: [name="Oracle"]I have reneged on my promise. I have betrayed she who waited within time itself.
speaker: Oracle
content: I have reneged on my promise. I have betrayed she who waited within time itself.

raw: [name="Oracle"]It is because of the love I felt. Love for life. Love for existence. Love is eternally pure. It leaves me unthinking.
speaker: Oracle
content: It is because of the love I felt. Love for life. Love for existence. Love is eternally pure. It leaves me unthinking.

raw: [name="Oracle"]Kal'tsit. Learn to love. Learn to believe. You have to think. Go and lead. Go and face the rolling stones that fall down the hills, screaming as they go.
speaker: Oracle
content: Kal'tsit. Learn to love. Learn to believe. You have to think. Go and lead. Go and face the rolling stones that fall down the hills, screaming as they go.

raw: [name="Oracle"]But in the end... I believe that you can learn to love. It is eternally pure. It is the child of every breathing creature. It is our nature.
speaker: Oracle
content: But in the end... I believe that you can learn to love. It is eternally pure. It is the child of every breathing creature. It is our nature.

raw: [name="Oracle"]Go. Kal'tsit. Go see your surroundings, then see what lies by the most distant of mountains. Go seek what forms existence takes. I must go back.
speaker: Oracle
content: Go. Kal'tsit. Go see your surroundings, then see what lies by the most distant of mountains. Go seek what forms existence takes. I must go back.

raw: [name="Oracle"]She had once taught me everything, once explored everything with fervor. But she has changed. She will not give me much time to act of my own accord.
speaker: Oracle
content: She had once taught me everything, once explored everything with fervor. But she has changed. She will not give me much time to act of my own accord.

raw: [name="Oracle"]May we meet again, next time. We will meet again. Kal'tsit.
speaker: Oracle
content: May we meet again, next time. We will meet again. Kal'tsit.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Legends are forgotten. Heroes pass out of memory.

raw: [name="Theresis"]And death arrives as it always does. None can escape it.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Perhaps after many years, those who were left behind and vanished after we built our home will join us in our causes.
speaker: Theresis
content: Perhaps after many years, those who were left behind and vanished after we built our home will join us in our causes.

raw: [name="Theresis"]They will bear a name wracked with infamy and settle this debate for us.
speaker: Theresis
content: They will bear a name wracked with infamy and settle this debate for us.

speaker: Theresa
content: Perhaps.

raw: The twins stand shoulder to shoulder.
content: The twins stand shoulder to shoulder.

raw: By means of the memories stored within the Black Crown, they walk along the battlefield of yesteryear. Just as it was in the past.
content: By means of the memories stored within the Black Crown, they walk along the battlefield of yesteryear. Just as it was in the past.

raw: The two mixed-blood Sarkaz step off the King's collapsed chariot, walking toward the battle...
content: The two mixed-blood Sarkaz step off the King's collapsed chariot, walking toward the battle...
Walking toward the future.

raw: [name="Theresis"]So is this where we part ways?
speaker: Theresis
content: So is this where we part ways?

raw: [name="Theresa"]It is. Here, where we joined hands to change Kazdel, we part.
speaker: Theresa
content: It is. Here, where we joined hands to change Kazdel, we part.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Even though you have been their King for so many years, at times... you are as you were back then.
speaker: Theresis
content: Even though you have been their King for so many years, at times... you are as you were back then.

raw: [name="Theresa"]Back when we were still young, I would often prick my fingers as I was sewing, staining the robes I would sell. Do you remember?
speaker: Theresa
content: Back when we were still young, I would often prick my fingers as I was sewing, staining the robes I would sell. Do you remember?

speaker: Theresis
content: Yes...

raw: [name="Theresa"]At the time, you were still a gloomy recruit, not allowed to wield a real sword, always dreaming of becoming a soldier of Kazdel one day.
speaker: Theresa
content: At the time, you were still a gloomy recruit, not allowed to wield a real sword, always dreaming of becoming a soldier of Kazdel one day.

raw: [name="Theresa"]I, for my part, still did not understand why we had to hide wherever we went.
speaker: Theresa
content: I, for my part, still did not understand why we had to hide wherever we went.

raw: [name="Theresa"]But then came the day that the Royal Court took note of my work, and I got to meet Yliš. During that meeting, I summoned my courage to ask the King of Sarkaz—
speaker: Theresa
content: But then came the day that the Royal Court took note of my work, and I got to meet Yliš. During that meeting, I summoned my courage to ask the King of Sarkaz—

speaker: Theresa
content: Where does our future lie?

raw: [name="Theresa"]He had no answer, only bidding me to leave.
speaker: Theresa
content: He had no answer, only bidding me to leave.

raw: [name="Theresa"]Only once I saw our defeated troops return to their homeland in ruins did I finally understand. The answer I sought could not be found in other lands, but 'here'—
speaker: Theresa
content: Only once I saw our defeated troops return to their homeland in ruins did I finally understand. The answer I sought could not be found in other lands, but 'here'—

speaker: Theresa
content: —In 'Kazdel'.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Kazdel will only return to glory when one of us is gone.
speaker: Theresis
content: Kazdel will only return to glory when one of us is gone.

raw: [name="Theresis"]But the one who is destined to lose is you. Must you persist with this, Theresa?
speaker: Theresis
content: But the one who is destined to lose is you. Must you persist with this, Theresa?

raw: [name="Theresa"]There are many by my side who support me.
speaker: Theresa
content: There are many by my side who support me.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Most Sarkaz who have suffered oppression and humiliation choose rebellion and violence.
speaker: Theresis
content: Most Sarkaz who have suffered oppression and humiliation choose rebellion and violence.

raw: [name="Theresis"]No matter if those who remain wish it or not, they will eventually be swept along by the tides and drawn into wars.
speaker: Theresis
content: No matter if those who remain wish it or not, they will eventually be swept along by the tides and drawn into wars.

raw: [name="Theresa"]But our generation must do something. I do not wish for this hatred in my hand to pass on to the next, where it will continue to fester and grow anew.
speaker: Theresa
content: But our generation must do something. I do not wish for this hatred in my hand to pass on to the next, where it will continue to fester and grow anew.

raw: [name="Theresa"]Even if I cannot change the future, the hope that will ignite the spark must be carried forward.
speaker: Theresa
content: Even if I cannot change the future, the hope that will ignite the spark must be carried forward.

raw: [name="Theresis"]I too must take charge of those who follow me.
speaker: Theresis
content: I too must take charge of those who follow me.

raw: [name="Theresis"]The cries answering the war do not come solely from Kazdel. There is no place for us anywhere in these lands.
speaker: Theresis
content: The cries answering the war do not come solely from Kazdel. There is no place for us anywhere in these lands.

raw: [name="Theresis"]All I can do is give them a push.
speaker: Theresis
content: All I can do is give them a push.

raw: [name="Theresis"]And so I will stay here. I choose to stay in the past, where the new generation of Sarkaz will one day look back.
speaker: Theresis
content: And so I will stay here. I choose to stay in the past, where the new generation of Sarkaz will one day look back.

speaker: Theresis
content: Just like you.
